sections.Profile:
The Flying Circus pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in May 1961, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features a circus and carnival theme.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Acrobatics, Circus, Clowns, Original Theme
